quests.title: Restore the Gallery light
quests.objective: Bring Mara the polished lens from the Gallery chest.
quests.completedText: Mara fitted the lens; the Gallery light shines again.

quests.title: The archive ledger
quests.objective: Find the archive ledger in the Storeroom and return it to the clerk in the Gallery east wing.
quests.completedText: The archive clerk has the ledger back.
